description: Calculate actual take-home pay after platform fees, optional currency-conversion cost (~2%), and optional per-withdrawal transaction fees, for 18 gig/creator/freelance/ecommerce platforms (Uber, YouTube, Upwork, Etsy, Airbnb, and more). Mirrors platformincome.com/take-home-pay.html exactly. Call list_take_home_platforms first if you don't already know a platform's id.

currency.description: 3-letter currency code, e.g. USD, GBP, EUR, NGN, INR. Defaults to USD.

grossAmount.description: Gross monthly earnings, before any fees.

includeCurrencyConversion.description: Add an estimated 2% currency-conversion cost on top of the platform fee.

includeTransactionFee.description: Add the platform's per-withdrawal transaction fee, where one applies (e.g. Uber Instant Pay, Upwork wire transfer). Ignored for platforms with no transaction fee.

period.description: Period to express the result in. grossAmount is always treated as a MONTHLY figure; period only changes the display breakdown.

platform.description: Platform id, e.g. 'uber-lyft', 'youtube', 'upwork'. Call list_take_home_platforms to see all valid ids.

name: take_home_pay_calculator
title: Take-Home Pay Calculator
